scope: Independent fixed stage1 IOMMU source review; no board access or deployment
status: compile-only candidate; not approved for deployment

findings.finding: TLB/PTW invalidation precedes PTE/L1 clearing and v20 iotlb_sync returns without a post-clear invalidation. Full L2 tables are freed immediately. A walker can refill an old translation or access freed table memory before unmap completion.
findings.required: Publish cleared entries, establish device visibility, invalidate both affected instances, prove completion, then allow data/table reuse.

findings.finding: Physical bits33:32 are encoded into PTE bits9:8, but later entries are generated by addition to an already encoded u32. Crossing a 4GiB physical boundary inside an L2 chunk loses the carry into the encoded high bits.
findings.example: RW page at PA 0xfffff000 followed by PA 0x100000000 needs the second high-address bit field 0x100, while u32 addition wraps it away.
findings.required: Encode each full-width physical page independently and validate boundary cases.

findings.finding: Page tables are ordinary pages/slab allocations. dma_sync_single calls receive virt_to_phys addresses without a corresponding DMA mapping; a zeroed L2 is published through its L1 descriptor without first establishing complete device visibility.
findings.required: Use a coherent DMA allocation design or explicitly mapped table ownership/handles, synchronize zeroed tables before descriptor publication, and preserve hardware address constraints.

findings.finding: v2 invalidation/flush uses set, fixed 10us delay, clear and always reports success. No T736 completion/status semantics have been established. READ_EQUAL_REG reads two instances but only returns instance0.
findings.required: Obtain version-correct completion semantics or a documented bounded protocol; do not substitute v3 self-clear polling at different offsets. Validate both instances and propagate failures.
findings.certainty: Absence of completion evidence is established; fixed 10us is not proven insufficient on hardware.

findings.finding: Singleton domain allocation is unsynchronized, hardware init failure still returns a domain, and domain free releases live page-table memory without a demonstrated blocked/detach path or switching the hardware TTB away.
findings.required: Define shared-domain and group ownership, allocate without exposing failed hardware initialization, serialize lifetime, and quiesce/detach masters before freeing tables. NULL allocation failure is handled by the Linux core and is not itself reported as a defect.

findings.finding: Default bypass mask is 0x3ff for 12 masters, leaving10/11 outside the default bypass set. of_xlate stores only the first iommus entry and silently accepts later entries without recording them; VE6/7 ownership is not implemented as a complete pair.
findings.required: Start all unrelated masters in bypass, validate argument count/range and own every required client master explicitly; never change live GPU/display/storage masters as a side effect.

findings.finding: Mapping over an existing PTE only WARNs and overwrites the old translation. map_pages ignores the L2 helper return value. Partial L1 allocations on failure have no explicit rollback.
findings.required: Reject mapping conflicts before replacing entries, propagate partial mapping/error accounting, and define allocation rollback.

findings.finding: ioremap_resource ERR_PTR is tested as NULL, and several PM power-get errors are ignored or only WARN before MMIO continues. Clock/reset/partial-probe rollback and global publication need a full pass.
findings.required: IS_ERR/PTR_ERR for mappings, checked power acquisition with balanced put, and complete probe failure unwind before publishing global state.

findings.finding: Global group publication is unsynchronized, allocation ERR_PTR can remain cached, notifier allocation survives the no-notifier branch, and of_find_device_by_node references are not put.
findings.required: Use defined group lifetime/ref ownership, clear failed publication, omit obsolete notifier allocations, and balance OF device references.

system_heap.status: Native Linux system_heap object linked per stage1 build record; no hardware runtime acceptance
system_heap.required_consumer_contract: System heap may supply discontiguous physical pages. Cedar consumer must use full dma-buf attach/map/unmap/detach lifetime, check contiguous complete DMA address extent and32bit ioctl range; first SG physical address is not a whole-buffer mapping.

documentation_limit: code_index checked A733 user manual IOMMU overview at extracted line23255: dual instances and two-level TLB described, no invalidation completion register definition. Donor v3 offsets0x98/0xa8 differ from v2 offsets0x54/0x6c, so completion semantics cannot be transferred.
